step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for CMOS Image Sensor Active Pixel Sensors (APS)
step1_figure.description: The circuit implements column-level delta-sigma sensing for CMOS APS by converting sampled reference (VR) and intensity (VI) voltages into currents via PMOS source-follower level shifters and switched-capacitor resistors, integrating the difference current onto a bucket capacitor, and using a clocked regenerative comparator with feedback to close the loop.

hold_capacitor_thermal_noise.description: RMS thermal noise voltage sampled onto the 1 pF hold capacitor (kT/C noise)

equation.explanation: Calculates the fundamental thermal noise floor of sampling onto hold capacitor C_H = 1 pF at room temperature (300 K).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined strictly by Boltzmann's constant, room temperature, and C_H = 1 pF.

vcol_linear_input_range_limit.description: Maximum column voltage (Vcol) for linear voltage-to-current conversion

equation.explanation: To keep the PMOS input follower operating with VSG approximately equal to |VTHP| and maintain conduction through the switched resistor, Vcol must stay below VDD - |VTHP|.

sky130_expected.reasoning: For SKY130 PMOS with typical threshold around 0.42 V, linear conversion requires Vcol < 1.38 V.

reference_shift_voltage.description: Effective voltage across the reference switched-capacitor resistor branch (VR,shift)

equation.explanation: Defines the effective voltage driving current through the reference branch after accounting for PMOS gate-source drop.
equation.assumptions: VDD = 1.8 V, |VTHP| = 0.42 V, VR = Vblack = 0.65 V

sky130_expected.reasoning: With 1.8 V supply and 0.65 V black/reference level, the shifted voltage is approximately 730 mV.

intensity_shift_voltage.description: Effective voltage across the light intensity switched-capacitor resistor branch (VI,shift)

equation.explanation: Defines the effective voltage driving current through the intensity branch.
equation.assumptions: VDD = 1.8 V, |VTHP| = 0.42 V, VI = Vinten = 0.645 V

sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 5 mV drop below reference (VI = 645 mV), VI,shift increases by 5 mV to 735 mV.

switched_capacitor_reference_resistance.description: Equivalent resistance of the reference switched-capacitor resistor branch (RR)

equation.explanation: Equivalent resistance created by switching cup capacitor C_cup at frequency f_clk.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by switching frequency of 100 MHz and 100 fF cup capacitance.

reference_branch_current.description: Average current flowing in the reference branch into the diode-connected NMOS mirror (IR)

equation.formula: I_R = V_R_shift / R_R = V_R_shift * f_clk * C_cup
equation.explanation: Calculates the average current integrated and mirrored by the reference path.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Nominal current delivered per cycle is C_cup * V_R_shift * f_clk.

dsm_modulator_count.description: Number of high clock cycles (M) out of total cycles (N) over the measurement period

equation.explanation: In DSM equilibrium, average charge added from intensity equals charge subtracted by reference mirror. M counts are generated when VI < VR.
equation.assumptions: N = 100 clock cycles over 1000 ns measurement window, V_R_shift = 0.73 V, V_I_shift = 0.735 V

sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 5 mV difference out of 730 mV shift with N = 100, the output produces ~1 pulse.

sensing_resolution.description: Voltage sensing resolution per LSB count of the modulator

equation.explanation: Minimum input voltage change resolvable with N clock cycles.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With N=100 samples, the shifted reference voltage of 730 mV is resolved to ~7.3 mV/count.

step3_testbench.description: Complete transient testbench measuring all operating voltages, reference currents, bucket voltages, and DSM output pulse counts for the CMOS imaging sensor delta-sigma modulator in Figure 17.33.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Figure 17.33: DSM Sensing Circuit for CMOS Imaging Chips
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}/models/sky130.lib.spice" tt

* Parameter definitions for device sizes
.param W_xm1=3.6u  L_xm1=0.18u
.param W_xm2=3.6u  L_xm2=0.18u
.param W_xm3=3.6u  L_xm3=0.18u
.param W_xm4=3.6u  L_xm4=0.18u
.param W_xm5=1.8u  L_xm5=1.8u
.param W_xm6=1.8u  L_xm6=1.8u
.param W_xm7=3.6u  L_xm7=0.18u
.param W_xm8=3.6u  L_xm8=0.18u
.param W_xm9=3.6u  L_xm9=0.18u
.param W_xm10=3.6u L_xm10=0.18u
.param W_xm11=1.8u L_xm11=0.18u
.param W_xm12=1.8u L_xm12=0.18u

* Power supplies and input DC levels
VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
Vblack Vblack 0 DC 0.650
Vinten Vinten 0 DC 0.645

* Sampling clock pulses (sample reference and intensity during initial 40 ns)
V_shr shr 0 PULSE(1.8 0 40n 0.1n 0.1n 2000n 2500n)
V_shi shi 0 PULSE(1.8 0 40n 0.1n 0.1n 2000n 2500n)

* Non-overlapping switched-capacitor clocks (Period = 10 ns, 100 MHz)
* PMOS switches: active LOW
V_phi1 phi1 0 PULSE(1.8 0 50.5n 0.2n 0.2n 3.5n 10n)
V_phi2 phi2 0 PULSE(1.8 0 55.0n 0.2n 0.2n 3.5n 10n)

* Comparator clock (active HIGH evaluation at end of phi2 phase)
V_clock clock 0 PULSE(0 1.8 58.5n 0.2n 0.2n 1.5n 10n)

* Core DSM sensing circuit (from Figure 17.33)
xm3 N002 phi1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm1 N004 phi2 N002 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N006 Out N004 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
C1 N002 0 1e-13
xm4 vbucket VI N006 N006 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
X_U1 vbucket vd4r Out Outi clock VDD 0 SUB_1
xm5 vbucket vd4r 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
C2 vbucket 0 5e-13
xm6 vd4r vd4r 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm7 N001 phi1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8 N003 phi2 N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
xm9 N005 0 N003 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
C3 N001 0 1e-13
xm10 vd4r VR N005 N005 sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
Chr VR 0 1e-12
xm11 VR shr Vblack 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
Chi VI 0 1e-12
xm12 VI shi Vinten 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}

* Subcircuit: Clocked Comparator with NAND SR Latch
.subckt SUB_1 inp inm q qi clock VDD GND
  xm1 N003 inp GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
  xm2 Outm Outp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
  xm3 Outp Outm VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm5 N002 Outm N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
  xm6 N001 Outp N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
  xm4 Outm clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
  xm7 Outp clock VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
  xm8 Outm clock N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm9 Outp clock N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
  xm10 N004 inm 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
  X_U1 Outp q qi VDD 0 NAND_2
  X_U2 qi Outm q VDD 0 NAND_2
.ends SUB_1

* Subcircuit: 2-input NAND Gate
.subckt NAND_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
  xm8 out A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
  xm11 N001 B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
  xm12 out A N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
.ends NAND_2

.control
tran 0.1n 1500n uic

* Measure sampled voltages on hold capacitors
meas tran v_sample_vr find v(VR) at=45n
meas tran v_sample_vi find v(VI) at=45n

* Measure shifted voltages across switched-cap resistors
let v_thp_est = 0.42
let vr_shift = 1.8 - v_thp_est - v_sample_vr
let vi_shift = 1.8 - v_thp_est - v_sample_vi
print vr_shift vi_shift

* Measure bucket and mirror voltages during modulation
meas tran v_bucket_avg avg v(vbucket) from=500n to=1500n
meas tran v_d4r_avg avg v(vd4r) from=500n to=1500n

* Calculate switched capacitor resistance (100 MHz, 100 fF)
let f_clock = 100e6
let c_cup = 100e-15
let r_r = 1.0 / (f_clock * c_cup)
let i_r = vr_shift / r_r
print r_r i_r

* Sensed resolution for N=100 samples
let n_samples = 100
let v_resolution = vr_shift / n_samples
print v_resolution

* Plot critical waveforms as requested in Baker's book
* plot v(vd4r) v(vbucket) v(Out)

quit
.endc
.end
